author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
Doctor Doom has some of the most… well, most rivalries in general in Marvel Comics history. Deep dive into the many rivalries of Doctor Doom as he attempts to free his mother’s soul from Mephisto, duels Iron Man in Camelot, and fights against both the X-Men and the Avengers in Part 2 of Marvel Recap: Doctor Doom.

00:00 - Doom VS Mephisto
06:49 - Doom VS Iron Man
13:27 - Doom VS X-Men 
17:51 - Doom VS The Avengers

author: Marvel Entertainment
description:
This week, we take a look at the epic finale of the Ultimate Universe in Marvel Comics’ Ultimate Endgame! Listen as Marvel Comics Editor-in-Chief CB Cebulski, Ultimates writer Deniz Camp, Ultimate Wolverine writer, Chris Condon, and Ultimate Spider-Man writer, Jonathan Hickman reflect on the past two years and share their experiences collaborating to bring this bold new vision of Marvel’s heroes to life.
